auth.failed.label: Authentication failed
auth.failed.explanation: A login attempt was rejected due to incorrect credentials; repeated failures from the same IP may trigger an authentication ban.

delivery.attempt-end.label: Delivery attempt ended
delivery.attempt-end.explanation: The outbound delivery attempt has finished, either successfully or with a temporary/permanent failure recorded.

delivery.attempt-start.label: Delivery attempt started
delivery.attempt-start.explanation: A new outbound SMTP delivery attempt is beginning; the server will look up MX records and try to connect to the recipient's mail server.

delivery.auth.label: SMTP authentication
delivery.auth.explanation: Authenticating with the remote server using the configured relay credentials.

delivery.auth-failed.label: SMTP authentication failed
delivery.auth-failed.explanation: The configured relay credentials were rejected by the remote server; delivery via this relay will fail.

delivery.completed.label: Delivery completed
delivery.completed.explanation: All recipients for this message have been either delivered or permanently failed; the message is removed from the queue.

delivery.concurrency-limit-exceeded.label: Concurrency limit exceeded
delivery.concurrency-limit-exceeded.explanation: The configured maximum number of simultaneous outbound connections to this remote host has been reached; delivery is deferred.

delivery.connect.label: Connecting to remote server
delivery.connect.explanation: A TCP connection is being established to the remote mail server for outbound delivery.

delivery.connect-error.label: Connection error
delivery.connect-error.explanation: The TCP connection to the remote mail server failed; another MX host will be tried if available.

delivery.delivered.label: Message delivered
delivery.delivered.explanation: The remote server accepted the message for the recipient with a 250 response; delivery is complete.

delivery.domain-delivery-start.label: New delivery attempt for domain
delivery.domain-delivery-start.explanation: An outbound delivery attempt is starting for a specific recipient domain; MX lookup and connection will follow.

delivery.double-bounce.label: Discarding message after double bounce
delivery.double-bounce.explanation: A bounce notification itself bounced; the message is permanently discarded to prevent a delivery loop.

delivery.dsn-perm-fail.label: DSN permanent failure notification
delivery.dsn-perm-fail.explanation: A permanent failure delivery status notification was generated; the sender is informed that the message cannot be delivered.

delivery.dsn-success.label: DSN success notification
delivery.dsn-success.explanation: A delivery success notification (DSN) was generated and queued for the original sender.

delivery.dsn-temp-fail.label: DSN temporary failure notification
delivery.dsn-temp-fail.explanation: A temporary failure delivery status notification was generated; the sender is informed that delivery is being retried.

delivery.ehlo.label: SMTP EHLO command
delivery.ehlo.explanation: The EHLO command was sent to the remote server to advertise capabilities and begin the SMTP session.

delivery.ehlo-rejected.label: SMTP EHLO rejected
delivery.ehlo-rejected.explanation: The remote server rejected the EHLO command; delivery to this host cannot proceed.

delivery.failed.label: Delivery failed
delivery.failed.explanation: The delivery attempt failed with a temporary error; the message will be rescheduled for a later retry.

delivery.greeting-failed.label: SMTP greeting failed
delivery.greeting-failed.explanation: The remote server did not send a valid SMTP 220 greeting after connection; the session cannot continue.

delivery.implicit-tls-error.label: Implicit TLS error
delivery.implicit-tls-error.explanation: The TLS handshake on the implicit TLS port (e.g. port 465) failed; the connection cannot be used.

delivery.ip-lookup.label: IP address lookup
delivery.ip-lookup.explanation: Resolving the IP address of an MX host before attempting a connection.

delivery.ip-lookup-failed.label: IP address lookup failed
delivery.ip-lookup-failed.explanation: DNS resolution of an MX hostname failed; this host will be skipped and the next MX record tried.

delivery.mail-from.label: SMTP MAIL FROM command
delivery.mail-from.explanation: The MAIL FROM command was sent to declare the envelope sender address to the remote server.

delivery.mail-from-rejected.label: SMTP MAIL FROM rejected
delivery.mail-from-rejected.explanation: The remote server rejected the MAIL FROM command; the sender address or domain may be blocked.

delivery.message-rejected.label: Message rejected by remote server
delivery.message-rejected.explanation: The remote server rejected the message data after accepting the envelope; a DSN will be generated.

delivery.missing-outbound-hostname.label: Missing outbound hostname in configuration
delivery.missing-outbound-hostname.explanation: No outbound EHLO hostname is configured; a hostname is required to present in the EHLO command to remote servers.

delivery.mx-lookup.label: MX record lookup
delivery.mx-lookup.explanation: Performing a DNS MX record lookup to determine which mail servers accept mail for the recipient domain.

delivery.mx-lookup-failed.label: MX record lookup failed
delivery.mx-lookup-failed.explanation: DNS returned no MX records or an error for the recipient domain; delivery to this domain cannot proceed.

delivery.null-mx.label: Null MX record found
delivery.null-mx.explanation: The recipient domain published a null MX record (RFC 7505), explicitly indicating it does not accept email; delivery is permanently impossible.

delivery.rate-limit-exceeded.label: Rate limit exceeded
delivery.rate-limit-exceeded.explanation: The configured outbound message rate limit for this remote host has been reached; delivery is deferred until the window resets.

delivery.rcpt-to.label: SMTP RCPT TO command
delivery.rcpt-to.explanation: The RCPT TO command was sent to specify the envelope recipient address to the remote server.

delivery.rcpt-to-failed.label: SMTP RCPT TO failed
delivery.rcpt-to-failed.explanation: The RCPT TO command could not be sent due to a connection error; delivery will be retried.

delivery.rcpt-to-rejected.label: SMTP RCPT TO rejected
delivery.rcpt-to-rejected.explanation: The remote server rejected the recipient address; a DSN will be generated for permanent failures.

delivery.start-tls.label: SMTP STARTTLS command
delivery.start-tls.explanation: Requesting a TLS upgrade on the existing SMTP connection to the remote server.

delivery.start-tls-disabled.label: STARTTLS disabled
delivery.start-tls-disabled.explanation: STARTTLS has been disabled in the configuration for this remote host; the connection will be plaintext.

delivery.start-tls-error.label: STARTTLS error
delivery.start-tls-error.explanation: The TLS handshake after STARTTLS failed; the connection may fall back to plaintext or be abandoned depending on policy.

delivery.start-tls-unavailable.label: STARTTLS unavailable
delivery.start-tls-unavailable.explanation: The remote server does not advertise STARTTLS; the connection will proceed unencrypted if policy allows.

message-ingest.duplicate.label: Skipping duplicate message
message-ingest.duplicate.explanation: An incoming message was detected as a duplicate of one already delivered; it has been discarded to prevent duplicates in the mailbox.

message-ingest.error.label: Message ingestion error
message-ingest.error.explanation: An error occurred while storing an inbound message; the message may not have been delivered to the recipient.

message-ingest.ham.label: Message ingested
message-ingest.ham.explanation: An inbound message passed spam checks and was successfully delivered to the recipient's mailbox.

message-ingest.imap-append.label: Message appended via IMAP
message-ingest.imap-append.explanation: A message was directly appended to a mailbox by an IMAP client using the APPEND command.

message-ingest.jmap-append.label: Message appended via JMAP
message-ingest.jmap-append.explanation: A message was directly appended to a mailbox via the JMAP Email/import method.

message-ingest.spam.label: Possible spam message ingested
message-ingest.spam.explanation: An inbound message was classified as likely spam and delivered to the Junk folder rather than the inbox.

milter.action-accept.label: Milter action: Accept
milter.action-accept.explanation: The Milter requested to accept the message

milter.action-connection-failure.label: Milter action: Connection failure
milter.action-connection-failure.explanation: The Milter requested a connection failure

milter.action-discard.label: Milter action: Discard
milter.action-discard.explanation: The Milter requested to discard the message

milter.action-reject.label: Milter action: Reject
milter.action-reject.explanation: The Milter requested to reject the message

milter.action-reply-code.label: Milter action: Reply code
milter.action-reply-code.explanation: The Milter requested a reply code

milter.action-temp-fail.label: Milter action: Temporary failure
milter.action-temp-fail.explanation: The Milter requested to temporarily fail the message

milter.io-error.label: Milter I/O error
milter.io-error.explanation: An I/O error occurred with the Milter

milter.timeout.label: Milter timeout
milter.timeout.explanation: A timeout occurred with the Milter

milter.tls-invalid-name.label: Invalid TLS name for Milter
milter.tls-invalid-name.explanation: The Milter TLS name is invalid

mta-hook.action-accept.label: MTA hook action: Accept
mta-hook.action-accept.explanation: The MTA hook requested to accept the message

mta-hook.action-discard.label: MTA hook action: Discard
mta-hook.action-discard.explanation: The MTA hook requested to discard the message

mta-hook.action-quarantine.label: MTA hook action: Quarantine
mta-hook.action-quarantine.explanation: The MTA hook requested to quarantine the message

mta-hook.action-reject.label: MTA hook action: Reject
mta-hook.action-reject.explanation: The MTA hook requested to reject the message

mta-hook.error.label: MTA hook error
mta-hook.error.explanation: An error occurred with the MTA hook

queue.authenticated-message-queued.label: Queued message submission for delivery
queue.authenticated-message-queued.explanation: A message submitted by an authenticated SMTP client was accepted and placed into the outbound delivery queue.

queue.autogenerated-queued.label: Queued autogenerated message for delivery
queue.autogenerated-queued.explanation: A system-generated message (e.g. calendar notification or auto-reply) was placed into the delivery queue.

queue.back-pressure.label: Queue backpressure detected
queue.back-pressure.explanation: Queue congested, processing can't keep up with incoming message rate

queue.blob-not-found.label: Message blob not found
queue.blob-not-found.explanation: The message body blob referenced by a queue entry could not be found in the blob store; the message cannot be delivered.

queue.concurrency-limit-exceeded.label: Concurrency limit exceeded
queue.concurrency-limit-exceeded.explanation: The maximum number of simultaneous outbound delivery connections has been reached; new deliveries are deferred.

queue.dsn-queued.label: Queued DSN for delivery
queue.dsn-queued.explanation: A delivery status notification (bounce or success) was placed into the queue for delivery back to the original sender.

queue.locked.label: Queue event is locked by another process
queue.locked.explanation: Another cluster node is already processing this queue event; this node will skip it to avoid duplicate delivery attempts.

queue.message-queued.label: Queued message for delivery
queue.message-queued.explanation: An inbound message was accepted and placed into the outbound delivery queue for processing.

queue.quota-exceeded.label: Quota exceeded
queue.quota-exceeded.explanation: The outbound queue size limit has been reached; new messages cannot be queued until existing ones are delivered or expired.

queue.rate-limit-exceeded.label: Rate limit exceeded
queue.rate-limit-exceeded.explanation: The outbound rate limit for the destination domain or relay has been reached; delivery is deferred until the window resets.

queue.report-queued.label: Queued report for delivery
queue.report-queued.explanation: A DMARC, TLS-RPT, or ARF report was placed into the delivery queue for sending to the recipient domain.

queue.rescheduled.label: Message rescheduled for delivery
queue.rescheduled.explanation: A delivery attempt failed with a temporary error; the message has been rescheduled for a later retry.

queue.started.label: MTA queue started
queue.started.explanation: The outbound MTA message queue has started and is ready to process and deliver queued messages.

security.abuse-ban.label: Banned due to abuse
security.abuse-ban.explanation: IP address was banned due to abuse, such as RCPT TO attacks

security.authentication-ban.label: Banned due to authentication errors
security.authentication-ban.explanation: IP address was banned due to multiple authentication errors

security.loiter-ban.label: Banned due to loitering
security.loiter-ban.explanation: IP address was banned due to multiple loitering events

security.scan-ban.label: Banned due to scan
security.scan-ban.explanation: IP address was banned due to exploit scanning

server.shutdown.label: Shutting down Stalwart Server
server.shutdown.explanation: A graceful shutdown has been initiated; active connections will be drained before the process exits.

server.startup.label: Starting Stalwart Server
server.startup.explanation: The server has finished initializing all subsystems and is now accepting connections.

smtp.connection-start.label: SMTP connection started
smtp.connection-start.explanation: A new SMTP connection was started

smtp.ehlo.label: SMTP EHLO command
smtp.ehlo.explanation: The remote server sent an EHLO command

smtp.invalid-ehlo.label: Invalid EHLO command
smtp.invalid-ehlo.explanation: The remote server sent an invalid EHLO command

smtp.mail-from.label: SMTP MAIL FROM command
smtp.mail-from.explanation: The remote client sent a MAIL FROM command

smtp.mail-from-not-allowed.label: MAIL FROM not allowed
smtp.mail-from-not-allowed.explanation: The remote client is not allowed to send mail from this address

smtp.mail-from-unauthenticated.label: MAIL FROM without authentication
smtp.mail-from-unauthenticated.explanation: The remote client did not authenticate before sending MAIL FROM

smtp.mail-from-unauthorized.label: MAIL FROM unauthorized
smtp.mail-from-unauthorized.explanation: The remote client is not authorized to send mail from the given address

smtp.mailbox-does-not-exist.label: Mailbox does not exist
smtp.mailbox-does-not-exist.explanation: The mailbox does not exist on the server

smtp.message-too-large.label: Message too large
smtp.message-too-large.explanation: The message was rejected because it was too large

smtp.rcpt-to.label: SMTP RCPT TO command
smtp.rcpt-to.explanation: The remote client sent an RCPT TO command

smtp.relay-not-allowed.label: Relay not allowed
smtp.relay-not-allowed.explanation: The server does not allow relaying

smtp.spf-from-fail.label: SPF From check failed
smtp.spf-from-fail.explanation: MAIL FROM identity failed SPF check

smtp.spf-from-pass.label: SPF From check passed
smtp.spf-from-pass.explanation: MAIL FROM identity passed SPF check

smtp.start-tls.label: SMTP STARTTLS command
smtp.start-tls.explanation: The remote client requested a TLS connection

smtp.time-limit-exceeded.label: Time limit exceeded
smtp.time-limit-exceeded.explanation: The remote host kept the SMTP session open too long

smtp.too-many-recipients.label: Too many recipients
smtp.too-many-recipients.explanation: The remote client exceeded the number of recipients allowed

spam.train-completed.label: Spam classifier training completed
spam.train-completed.explanation: The FTRL-Proximal logistic regression spam classifier training run finished, was stopped, or had no samples to train on; when the run trained on new samples, the updated model is now active.

telemetry.events-dropped.label: Telemetry events dropped
telemetry.events-dropped.explanation: Events were discarded because producers or tracers could not keep up with the event rate; logs and traces for this period are incomplete. The total key holds the number of events dropped since the last report.

tls.handshake-error.label: TLS handshake error
tls.handshake-error.explanation: A TLS handshake failed; the client may not support the configured TLS version or cipher, or presented an invalid certificate.
